recognize_zh: 密集的異常前骨髓球，胞質含紫紅色顆粒、核摺疊；箭頭指的細胞胞質中隱約可見覆蓋在核上的細條棒狀結構，疑為成束的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），但此解析度難以完全確認。
features: Densely packed abnormal promyelocytes with folded, reniform, or bilobed nuclei
Cytoplasm with abundant fine azurophilic granules and granular background
Arrowed cell shows faint linear rod-like structures overlying the nucleus, suggestive of bundled Auer rods (faggot cell)
Monotonous infiltrate with little normal hematopoietic maturation
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a dense population of abnormal promyelocytes with folded to bilobed nuclei and granular cytoplasm. The arrowed cell contains faint linear cytoplasmic structures overlapping the nucleus, suggestive of multiple Auer rods in a bundle (faggot cell), although this is not unequivocal at the current resolution. Normal maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are scant. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; confirmation by PML::RARA FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Blasts in t(8;21) usually contain a single, long, slender Auer rod and a perinuclear hof with maturing dysplastic neutrophils, not bundles of Auer rods in bilobed promyelocytes.
The microgranular variant has bilobed nuclei but sparse visible granules, whereas these cells are overtly hypergranular; both carry PML::RARA.
Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and a full maturation sequence, and never contain Auer rods.
